title: GST के साथ Expenses और Assets
intro:
भाग 6 — GST Advanced

कुल Problems: 4 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🟠 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Expense/Asset की खरीद पर ITC और Blocked Credit समझना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

Expense Ledger में GST Applicable

Blocked Credit (Catering आदि) में ITC न लें

Capital Goods ITC अलग देखें

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Catering का ITC ले लेना

Composition से खरीद पर GST मान लेना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

Expense/Asset/Service Ledger में भी 'Is GST Applicable = Yes' व सही HSN/SAC-Taxability भरें, तभी ITC सही Claim होगी। कुछ Expenses (जैसे Catering, Employee Food, Club Membership) पर Section 17(5) के तहत ITC पूरी तरह Blocked होती है — ऐसे Ledger में ITC Eligibility = 'Ineligible' रखें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Create the Expense/Asset/Service Ledgers with correct GST details in Tally Prime, pass the Purchase/Payment Vouchers, and verify which amounts are ITC-claimable in GSTR-2/GSTR-3B.
guide:
GST के साथ Expenses और Assets

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

ध्यान दें

दरें GST 2.0 (22-Sep-2025 से लागू) के अनुसार हैं। Practice में Question की दी हुई दर ही लगाएँ। असली Business में ITC के नियम (जैसे Blocked Credit) अपने CA से पक्का करें।

सबसे पहले — Expense/Asset पर GST की तैयारी

  • Expense Ledger बनाएँ (Indirect Expenses) → GST Applicable = Yes, HSN/SAC और दर भरें।
  • Fixed Asset का Ledger Under = Fixed Assets; GST Applicable = Yes।
  • Party Ledger में State, GSTIN और Registration Type सही भरें।
  • Purchase Voucher (F9) → Accounting Invoice Mode (Ctrl+H) → Party → Expense/Asset Ledger → रकम → Tax अपने-आप जुड़ेगा।
  • ITC न मिलने वाली (Blocked) रकम के लिए Ledger में "Ineligible for Input Credit" चुनें (या Tax Ledger का उपयोग न करें, पूरा Expense में डालें)।
  • जाँच: GST Reports → GSTR-2 / GSTR-3B (ITC Eligible/Ineligible)।
याद रखें

Blocked ITC (Sec 17(5)) के उदाहरण: Food/Catering, Club Membership, निजी उपयोग का माल।

Capital Goods पर ITC मिलता है (नियम सहित)।

Composition Dealer GST नहीं लगाता, इसलिए ITC भी नहीं बनता।

Intra-State: CGST + SGST; Inter-State: IGST।

problems.title: GST on Office Rent (Expense) — ITC Claimable
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Paid Office Rent ₹ 20,000 + GST 18% to Landlord (Regular Dealer, Local)
problems.hint:
• Rent Ledger: Under = Indirect Expenses; GST Applicable, SAC 9972, 18%।
  • Voucher (Purchase Accounting Mode) — Landlord (Regular, Local): Rent ₹20,000 + CGST 9% + SGST 9%।
problems.full:

Rent20,000
CGST 9%1,800
SGST 9%1,800
Invoice Total23,600
ITC Claimable3,600
✅ Check

Invoice Total = ₹23,600 • ITC Claimable = ₹3,600 (पूरा व्यावसायिक उपयोग) ✔

problems.title: GST on Fixed Asset Purchase — Office Printer
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

Printer एक Fixed Asset (Capital Good) है — Ledger 'Office Equipment' के Under बनाएँ, GST Applicable रखें।

  • 1st April — Purchased 1 Printer for Office Use ₹ 25,000 + GST 18% from HP Dealer (Regular, Local)
problems.hint:
• Ledger "Office Equipment" → Under = Fixed Assets; GST Applicable, HSN 8443, 18%।
  • Purchase Voucher — HP Dealer (Regular, Local): Printer ₹25,000 + CGST 9% + SGST 9%।
  • ITC Capital Goods वाले हिस्से में दिखेगा।
problems.full:
मदरकम (₹)
Printer (Fixed Asset)25,000
CGST 9% + SGST 9%4,500
Invoice Total29,500
ITC Claimable (Capital Goods)4,500
✅ Check

Invoice Total = ₹29,500 • ITC Claimable = ₹4,500 (Capital Goods) ✔

problems.title: GST on Professional/Audit Fees — Inter-State Service
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

  • 1st April — Paid Audit Fees ₹ 1,00,000 + GST 18% to a CA Firm, Haryana (Regular Dealer, Inter-State)
problems.hint:
• Ledger "Audit Fees" → Under = Indirect Expenses; SAC 9954/9982, 18%।
  • CA Firm, Haryana (Regular, Inter-State) → इसलिए IGST: Audit Fees ₹1,00,000 + IGST 18%।

problems.title: Mixed Expenses — Blocked Credit, Composition Purchase & Normal ITC
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

Catering/Food Service पर ITC Section 17(5) के तहत BLOCKED है (GST चुकाने पर भी Claim नहीं); Composition Dealer से खरीद पर GST ही नहीं लगता।

  • 2nd April — Paid for Office Party Catering ₹ 50,000 + GST 5% to Shiva Caterers (Regular Dealer, Local)
  • 2nd April — Purchased Packing Material ₹ 15,000 from Sanjay Plastic Works (Composition Dealer, Local — no GST charged)
  • 2nd April — Purchased Stationery ₹ 2,000 + GST 18% from Vikram Stationery (Regular Dealer, Local)
problems.hint:
• Catering (Shiva Caterers, Regular): Catering Expense Dr ₹50,000 + GST 5% (₹2,500) — पूरी रकम Expense में, GST Ledger में नहीं (ITC Blocked)।
  • Packing Material (Sanjay Plastic Works, Composition): ₹15,000 Purchase/Expense — कोई GST नहीं, Bill of Supply।
  • Stationery (Vikram Stationery, Regular): ₹2,000 + CGST 9% + SGST 9% = ₹2,360; ITC ₹360।
